identity.name: Tessera
identity.description: Surfaces Tessera-indexed KChat channels and lets you push artifacts back into KChat without leaving the chat client.

procedures.rationale: Read recent messages from channels the user has chosen to index so Tessera can ingest them as sources.
Enumerate conversations so the sources panel can show which channels are indexed and which are not.
Post an artifact share message (link + optional evidence-pack reference) back into the conversation the user selected.

views.title: Tessera Sources
views.description: Shows the KChat channels currently indexed by Tessera, with quick links to source detail and a button to ingest the current channel.
